recap.text: Donut's Apothecary tiara doubles her charisma from 138 to 276, enough to leave the high elves' provincial boss Ferdinand, whose total is 175, 101 points behind. It dissolves after thirty hours. She sings All Eyes on Me, and the whole room turns to her, the queen and Carl among them. Afterward, Carl feels the tiara is gone, lost in the battle.

beats.headline: No hidden seven
beats.text: Of the five Apothecary items on the table, all meant for Donut, Carl understands three: a recharge wand scroll, a sheet of music and a new tiara. It is the stick and the hammer that puzzle him, and each carries a hidden seven. He checks the others. The scroll has no symbol that he can find, and neither does the tiara or the sheet music. That makes sense, he thinks. Their purpose is clear.
beats.gist: Carl finds no hidden seven on the tiara, scroll or sheet music, since their purpose is clear.

beats.headline: Good with the dinosaurs
beats.text: The caravan is escorting the party to the castle, and new guards in black jackets keep coming. Carl tells Donut to keep Tina under control: they have waited long enough, so put the new tiara on. She already has, Donut replies, and it has helped a lot with the dinosaurs, but the guards are still agitated, probably because of the lady in the last cart.
beats.gist: Donut says the new tiara already calmed the dinosaurs, but the guards in black jackets stay agitated.

beats.headline: Ugly, and temporary
beats.text: At the castle, Donut complains that her charm upgrade is not working on the high elves. It is working fine, Carl tells her: these elves think the party is beneath them, and someone has left them with a negative opinion, so the fact they are talking at all is a sign. He is only bummed it is not permanent. This tiara is ugly anyway, Donut says. But don't tell the Apothecary lady she said so.
beats.gist: Donut says her tiara isn't working on the castle's high elves; Carl says their talking proves it is.

beats.headline: Two hundred and seventy-six
beats.text: Donut's unenhanced charisma sits at 138, and the benefactor-box tiara on her head doubles it, to a god-like 276 before the saferoom buffs. Once placed, it only lasts thirty hours before it dissolves. According to Mistress Tiatha, an NPC fawns over a crawler when the crawler's charisma beats the NPC's constitution and charisma together, by a hundred points for a province boss, which is what Ferdinand is. His total is 175. Donut is 101 over, and with her buffs and the Seize the Day Toothpaste, her effective charm is well over 300.
beats.gist: Donut's tiara doubles her charisma to 276, enough to make province boss Ferdinand fawn over her.

beats.headline: All eyes on her
beats.text: The spotlight narrows on Donut alone on stage, her tiara glittering. She does not take out her sheet music, because she does not need it. She sings a song her mother used to sing to her, All Eyes on Me, with Britney on guitar backstage. It is a charm spell that focuses everyone's attention on a subject of the caster's choosing, and with Donut's insane charisma it catches the whole room, the queen and Carl included. Only Signet seems unaffected.
beats.gist: Donut sings All Eyes on Me, a charm spell, and her charisma holds the whole room except Signet.

beats.headline: Elves in love
beats.text: Atop Mongo and matted with gore, Donut is giddy. She was wrong about her charisma not working: her love vampire skill works really well when it is this high. Behind her, elves wade through the fray with little heart icons over them. It does not work on the bugs. We need to get her charisma that high permanently, Carl thinks.
beats.gist: Donut's love vampire skill charms elves but not bugs, so Carl wants her charisma kept that high.

beats.headline: Gone in the battle
beats.text: After the fight, sticky with blood, Donut asks Carl why it does not hurt as much as it should, and she circles once and settles into the crook of his arm, the way they used to so long ago. Running his hand across her bloody, matted head, Carl realizes her temporary, charisma-gaining crown is gone, lost in the battle. She has taken off her sunglasses, too.
beats.gist: Donut's charisma-boosting tiara is gone from the battle, and she curls into Carl's arm without her sunglasses.
